# D's press takes over slot 1, assigned longest ago; B's then takes
# over slot 0, the only provisional slot.
@0 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 1 "Pad A" key=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 provisional
@10 slot 1 gen=1 <- id 2 "Pad B" key=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 home=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 provisional
@100 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 3 "Pad C" key=030000000c0000000c00000000000000 home=030000000a0000000a00000000000000 provisional handoff
@200 slot 1 gen=1 <- id 4 "Pad D" key=030000000d0000000d00000000000000 home=030000000d0000000d00000000000000 handoff takeover
@300 slot 0 gen=1 <- id 2 "Pad B" key=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 home=030000000b0000000b00000000000000 handoff takeover
